name: io.github.justyns/silverbullet-ai-mcp
description: Exposes silverbullet-ai tools from a SilverBullet space to MCP clients

environmentVariables.name: SB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your SilverBullet server, or 'desktop' for the SilverBullet+ desktop app

environmentVariables.name: SB_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The server's SB_AUTH_TOKEN, if it runs with token auth

environmentVariables.name: SB_SPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: In desktop mode, which space to connect to
